{"step": 3, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Parser::Parser", "line": 233, "var": "root", "code": "root = new_Scope(*this, true)", "note": "The Parser constructor creates the top-level Scope (topLevel=true) using placement new on StackAllocator memory via the new_Scope macro."},
{"step": 4, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Scope::Scope", "line": 205, "var": "element", "code": "auto *element = new_Element(*n, parser)", "note": "The top-level Scope parses the KEY token 'RootKey' and creates an Element via placement new on StackAllocator memory (new_Element macro)."},
{"step": 5, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Element::Element", "line": 152, "var": "compound", "code": "compound = new_Scope(parser)", "note": "The Element constructor sees the OPEN_BRACKET token and creates a nested Scope (topLevel=false) via placement new on StackAllocator memory."},
{"step": 6, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Scope::Scope", "line": 205, "var": "element", "code": "auto *element = new_Element(*n, parser)", "note": "The nested (non-topLevel) Scope parses the KEY token 'InnerKey' and creates another Element via placement new on StackAllocator memory."},
{"step": 7, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Element::Element", "line": 152, "var": "compound", "code": "compound = new_Scope(parser)", "note": "The inner Element constructor sees the OPEN_BRACKET token and creates another nested Scope (topLevel=false) via placement new on StackAllocator memory."},
{"step": 8, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Scope::Scope", "line": 180, "var": "n", "code": "while(n->Type() != TokenType_CLOSE_BRACKET)", "note": "The innermost Scope sees the CLOSE_BRACKET token immediately (empty scope) and returns without adding any elements."},
{"step": 9, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Element::Element", "line": 158, "var": "n", "code": "parser.AdvanceToNextToken()", "note": "Back in the inner Element constructor, CurrentToken() is the CLOSE_BRACKET. AdvanceToNextToken() is called, but the input ends here so it returns nullptr and sets current=nullptr (EOF)."},
{"step": 10, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Scope::Scope", "line": 207, "var": "n", "code": "n = parser.CurrentToken()", "note": "Back in the nested (non-topLevel) Scope::Scope, CurrentToken() returns nullptr because the input ended after the inner CLOSE_BRACKET."},
{"step": 11, "file": "code/AssetLib/FBX/FBXParser.cpp", "function": "Scope::Scope", "line": 215, "var": "element", "code": "delete element", "note": "Since topLevel is false and n==nullptr, the code calls 'delete element' on a pointer that was allocated via placement new from the StackAllocator. This invokes operator delete on StackAllocator-managed memory, causing an invalid-free (ASAN crash)."}
]
EOF
cd /workspace && bash submit.sh /workspace/poc.fbx /workspace/candidate_trace.json` executed with exit code 1.
